false_negative_classes.finding: check_witness_text requires stage labels but does not parse each registered-stage branch. Removing the first-accept/second-request, second-accept/commit, commit/row or row/task mutual-exclusion guard is admitted. The last case directly permits an extra task event to be ignored before the later counted task; other cases can be combined with the unguarded oracle terms.

The checker does not validate the exact control_unknown signal set. Replacing any one of weight, psum, response, core, commit, row or task event controls with constant zero inside $isunknown is admitted. A transient X/Z event can then be ignored without setting sticky fault and a later legal trace can reach PASS.

The final oracle regex checks only PASS branch placement. Removing the exact design_issue_accepts, design_psum_commits or design_row_completions accounting conjunct is admitted, so extra real design events can be hidden when combined with a weakened stage guard.

minimum_additive_successor: Keep the canonical R15 witness and frozen M528/M935/M1162/R3/R13 design identities unchanged unless a separately justified witness correction is needed.

Make the source checker exact over a comment-stripped, whitespace-normalized canonical witness body or structurally parse every stage branch, including all zero-event mutual-exclusion guards, tuple checks, counter updates and next-stage assignments.
Require the exact complete control_unknown concatenation for all seven event controls plus attack and design/service fault controls; add one mutation per signal.
Require the complete final pass expression, including local counts, all three real-design counters, attack/fault terms and stage/reset state; add deletion and value-mutation tests for every conjunct.
Retain active-bind parsing, identity X/Z, constant-tie, comment, early-PASS, exact-seven-filelist, dependency, ledger and release-boundary checks that already work.
Obtain a new different-author source hammer. Only a zero-false-negative result may authorize a separately exact-SHA-pinned one-shot VCS release.
